name: Wm. R. Snider
role: Major, editor of the Spearfish Register
bio: Maj. W. R. Snider, editor of the Spearfish Register, visited Medora in April 1884. In May 1884 the Cow Boy reprinted a Black Hills Pioneer item calling him the best editorial writer in Dakota and reporting his belief that a railroad from the Northern Pacific would soon be built. In July 1884 he and Dr. Louthan showed the Cow Boy's party around Spearfish.
